meta_description: Noise-robust knee and elbow detection in your browser: a knee with its uncertainty or a frank abstention. Nothing is uploaded.
guide1: Pick an example curve or paste your own points (y values alone or x,y pairs).
guide2: Click Analyze. The verdict, the diagnostic figure and the confidence interval are computed in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
paste_placeholder: One point per line: a single y value, or an x,y pair separated by a comma, a space or a tab. A CSV header line is ignored.
upload_aria: Import a CSV file of points
status_booting: Starting the Python engine (first visit: a one-time download)…
status_running: Validating the knee: scale-space search, bootstrap and no-knee null test…
status_done: Computed in {s} s in your browser.
error_parse: Could not read any point. Expected one y per line or x,y pairs.
error_too_few: Only {n} points; the pipeline needs at least 20.
verdict_placeholder: Pick a curve and click Analyze.
verdict_clear_body: 90% confidence interval: {lo} to {hi}. Found again in {rate}% of bootstrap resamples; the chance of such a knee on knee-free data is {p}.
reason_INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Fewer than 20 points; the validation stages need more.
reason_INVALID_INPUT: The input contains values the pipeline cannot use (NaN, infinities or mismatched lengths).
reason_ZERO_RANGE: x or y is constant; there is no curve to bend.
reason_INCOMPATIBLE_GLOBAL_SHAPE: The data does not follow the requested shape or direction closely enough.
reason_NO_KNEE_CANDIDATES: The scale-space search found no candidate knee at any smoothing level.
reason_ALL_CANDIDATES_WEAK: Candidates exist but none stands out from the noise.
reason_NO_PERSISTENT_CLUSTER: No candidate location persists across smoothing scales.
reason_MULTIPLE_PLAUSIBLE_KNEES: Several distinct locations are equally plausible; picking one would be arbitrary.
reason_BOUNDARY_KNEE: The best candidate sits too close to the edge of the data.
reason_WEAK_SLOPE_CHANGE: The slope change at the candidate is too small to matter.
reason_SEGMENTED_MODEL_NOT_BETTER: A two-segment fit does not beat a single trend by enough.
reason_BOOTSTRAP_UNSTABLE: The candidate moves too much when the data is resampled.
reason_NULL_NOT_REJECTED: A knee this strong also appears on knee-free surrogate data.
reason_INTERNAL_NUMERICAL_FAILURE: A numerical step failed; nothing trustworthy to report.
footer_engine: The detection runs in your browser (WebAssembly); no data leaves your machine.
